verdict.rationale: Bento is an AI-agent observability and improvement platform with its own AI-driven features, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents Bento connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools. The only MCP mention (docs-2) describes coding agents such as Claude Code loading Bento's docs over MCP, which is the opposite direction (Bento serving content) and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
